news.title: ‘We need more reviewers’: Finding Linux bugs is easy now – fixing them is another story
news.dek: Some Linux maintainers are quitting under the crushing strain of AI bug reports, while others see signs for hope.
news.aiSummary: Linux maintainers are facing significant pressure due to an influx of AI-generated bug reports, leading some to quit their roles. While finding bugs has become easier, the burden of fixing them is causing strain, though some maintainers remain optimistic about the situation.

news.title: SpaceX launches Starship in key test flight of massive rocket
news.dek: The test flight is SpaceX's first attempt to ​catch both the Super Heavy booster and upper stage spacecraft of the rocket at its launch site in Starbase, Texas.
news.aiSummary: SpaceX launched its Starship rocket for a significant test flight from Starbase, Texas. This mission marks the company's first attempt to catch both the Super Heavy booster and the upper stage spacecraft at the launch site.

news.title: India pins hopes on AI start-up to avoid becoming ‘digital colony’
news.dek: Sarvam has received government backing to build native models in world’s most populous country
news.aiSummary: The Indian government is supporting the AI startup Sarvam to develop indigenous artificial intelligence models. This initiative aims to ensure that the world's most populous country maintains digital sovereignty and avoids becoming a 'digital colony' dependent on external technology.

news.title: Tech Now
news.dek: Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths follows a team testing AI early warning systems for landslides.
news.aiSummary: Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths reports on a team that is testing early warning systems powered by artificial intelligence. These systems are specifically designed to detect and predict the occurrence of landslides.

news.title: Even Grand Theft Auto's original creators haven't been able to play GTA 6
news.dek: The next title in the series is expected to be the biggest video game release ever.
news.aiSummary: The upcoming GTA 6 is anticipated to be the biggest video game release ever. Even the original creators of the series have not yet played it.

news.title: White House Urges Easing Liability to Encourage AI Disclosure
news.dek: At a White House meeting on Thursday, officials from President Donald Trump’s artificial intelligence task force recommended that agencies ease their cyber liability policies in an effort to incentivize AI companies to report critical incidents.
news.aiSummary: Officials from President Donald Trump's artificial intelligence task force met at the White House to recommend that government agencies relax their cyber liability policies. The goal of this recommendation is to incentivize AI companies to voluntarily report critical incidents.

news.title: Fed’s Jefferson Says Inflation Will Determine Rate Decisions
news.dek: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said inflation has become the most important measure for policymakers as they consider additional interest-rate hikes.
news.aiSummary: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson stated that inflation is now the primary metric guiding policy decisions. He emphasized that this focus will shape any future interest-rate increases.

news.title: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
news.dek: Amazon has plans to build a vault of data on every product sold anywhere on the internet, even products Amazon doesn't sell, and make the information available through its own site, according to Reuters. The project, called the "World Product Graph," is meant to make it less like
news.aiSummary: Amazon is developing a project called the World Product Graph to build a vault of data on every product sold on the internet, including items it does not sell itself. The initiative aims to make this information available through Amazon's own site to improve the shopping experience.

news.title: Sam Bankman-Fried would have made nearly $40bn in Anthropic IPO
news.dek: Jailed cryptocurrency mogul loses out on windfall from early investment in the AI lab
news.aiSummary: Sam Bankman-Fried, who is currently incarcerated, would have earned approximately $40 billion from an early investment in Anthropic had the AI lab gone public. His current legal status means he is unable to realize this significant financial windfall.

news.title: SpaceX Starship Launches on Flight Test of Reusability
news.dek: SpaceX’s Starship rocket took off from the Starbase launch facility in South Texas on a flight test to bring both sections of the vehicle safely back to Earth. Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.aiSummary: SpaceX's Starship rocket launched from the Starbase facility in South Texas for a flight test. The mission aimed to safely return both sections of the vehicle to Earth.

news.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1
news.dek: GS Caltex connects Amazon SageMaker Canvas to Amazon SageMaker Pipelines so process engineers' no-code models run in production. This post shows how ML engineers reuse validated preprocessing flows and models, cutting deployment from about a week to a few hours and running batch
news.aiSummary: GS Caltex integrates Amazon SageMaker Canvas with Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to enable process engineers to deploy no-code models into production environments. By reusing validated preprocessing flows and models, ML engineers have reduced deployment times from approximately one week to a few hours while supporting batch processing.

news.title: datasette-cluster-map 0.19
news.dek:

 One of the oldest Datasette plugins, and still one of my favorites. It now works with Datasette 1.0a42, and depends on  the new datasette-leaflet  to ensure OpenStreetMap tiles are requested with a referrer header. 
 Here's  a map of power
news.aiSummary: The datasette-cluster-map plugin, version 0.19, is now compatible with Datasette 1.0a42. It relies on the new datasette-leaflet dependency to ensure OpenStreetMap tiles are requested with a referrer header.

news.dek:

 OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server  should send a referrer header . Datasette table pages used the  Referrer-Policy: no-referrer  HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to
news.aiSummary: The datasette-leaflet plugin has released version 0.3 to address compatibility issues with OpenStreetMap. The update resolves a problem where Datasette's 'Referrer-Policy: no-referrer' header prevented plugins from successfully loading tiles from OpenStreetMap's hosted server.

news.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
news.dek: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.
news.aiSummary: Shield employs OpenAI to assist IT technicians in transferring tasks from legacy portals. The system’s Forge agents guide users through the portals, allowing technicians to concentrate on problems that require human judgment.
